description:
This is not a solicitation, but rather a SOURCES SOUGHT ANNOUNCEMENT to acquire a company able to tear down, evaluate, and repair the RT-4110 Blade Radio, part number 270-3186-070. The Statement of Work (SOW) is found in Attachment 1: “Blade Radio Repair, Statement of Work, 28 January 2026”.

In accordance with FAR Part 10, Market Research, Headquarters at the Utah Test and Training Range/A4L is seeking information for potential sources for the tear down, evaluate, and repair of the RT-4110 Blade Radio, part number 270-3186-070.
